notes.title: Prologue update with bug fixes and huge performance boost!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

Just a quick update to let you all know that we have just [b]fixed the bugs[/b] people had been encountering in the prologue and also gave it a [b]massive performance boost[/b]! 

We really appreciate all the feedback you have been giving us so far. Please do let us know what you think of the new update to the prologue, and any other bugs if you find them.

[h2]New Art Assets and Locations in Imagined Leviathans[/h2]

Here’s a look at a couple of the new art assets from the main game that we’re working on:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38709509/826a4270d310db99641bf44d8133b41bd3026e8e.gif[/img]
[i]Hamlet Square bridge[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38709509/97b48c9e29c0080d7d1691b3d5cfa4ba089fd444.gif[/img]
[i]Abandoned Hospital[/i]

[h2]Wishlist Imagined Leviathans [/h2]

Our work on the main game, ‘Imagined Leviathans’ is ticking along nicely, and we're so excited to share the full version with you all soon! In the meantime, don’t forget to add it to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1528030/Imagined_Leviathans/

That’s all for now,
[i]Happy surviving!
[/i]

notes.title: Major new update to The Imagined Leviathan: Prologue!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

As you may already know, we have recently rebranded ‘[i]The Imagined Leviathan[/i]’ to be an official Prologue for our upcoming release, ‘[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1528030/Imagined_Leviathans/]Imagined Leviathans[/url]’. 

[h2]Updates![/h2]

We have just released a major new patch for [i]The Imagined Leviathan: Prologue[/i], which now acts as the first 20-30 minutes of play for the main game. There are now a lot of exciting new features for you to try out - most significantly, some new story elements which include [b]the ability to explore interiors[/b]!

[h3]Interior encounters[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38709509/0eab9084d494785446fa411e9d980140c483bd42.gif[/img]


There is a completely [b]new tutorial area[/b] and lots of [b]new locations to explore[/b] as part of this update. Not all areas in the full game are accessible from the prologue of course, but the huge open world is now visible from certain locations.

[h3]Bigger world[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38709509/41a968bfed48c9424443ed5b767976a01464c262.gif[/img]


There are a number of [b]new art assets[/b] throughout the game which we are constantly improving on. We have also made further improvements to the navigation controls, as well as the fire building and fog mechanics.

[h3]New location previews[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38709509/d316381ab9f0f2bca9056d5262d91eafe60e0eb3.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38709509/6e0cd85a8bdc70f81f5dce3cd37681b75357eeb8.gif[/img]


Please feel free to make use of our new [b]in-game bug reporting feature[/b] - you can use the new (brief) feedback form accessible via the pause menu to let us know what you think of the update.

[h2]The future[/h2]

We’re planning to release weekly updates to the prologue as we get closer to the final release. We’ve been working really hard to expand our original prototype into a much bigger game that has a full 2-3 hours of play with significantly more to do and see. We’re aiming to have [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1528030/Imagined_Leviathans/]Imagined Leviathans[/url] ready for sometime next month, but more on that soon!

In the meantime, wishlist Imagined Leviathans below!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1528030/Imagined_Leviathans/

[i]Happy surviving!
[/i]
